'''Hapoel Ironi Kiryat Shmona Football Club''' ({{langx|he|מועדון כדורגל הפועל עירוני קרית שמונה}}) known as '''Ironi Kiryat Shmona''' is a professional [[Association football|football]] club based in [[Kiryat Shmona]],<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.spiegel.de/international/europe/the-secret-behind-israel-s-star-soccer-team-kiryat-shmona-a-856529.html |title=The Secret Behind Israel's Star Soccer Team Kiryat Shmona – SPIEGEL ONLINE |publisher=Spiegel.de |date=2012-09-19 |access-date=2013-12-02|newspaper=Spiegel Online |last1=Mittelstaedt |first1=Juliane von }}</ref> in the northern district of [[Israel]]. The club is a current member of the [[Israeli Premier League]], and plays at the [[Kiryat Shmona Municipal Stadium|Ironi Stadium]].<ref name="football.org.il"/> They won their first league title in [[2011–12 Israeli Premier League|2011–12]].

The Roaring Lion statue on the team's logo is a well-known monument. It commemorates the casualties of the [[Tel Hai]] battle that happened north of Kiryat Shmona on March 1, 1920."}}
